text:
Situation: Regadenoson 0.08 mg/mL 5 mL syringes at Corvale East total 71 units, providing 21.4 days of supply at the current 3.3 syringes per day usage rate.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show regadenoson is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for approximately three weeks. Multiple manufacturers have product available and none appear on FDA's shortage list today. No allocation or allocation notice has been received.

Recommended actions:
1. Place a routine replenishment order with Astellas Pharma US, Inc. — approved by the pharmacy buyer.
2. If Astellas cannot fulfill, place a routine replenishment order with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (Berkeley Heights plant) — approved by the pharmacy buyer.
3. If the first two sources cannot fulfill, evaluate Accord Healthcare Inc., Apotex Corp., and Baxter Healthcare Corporation as backup sources — approved by the pharmacy buyer.
4. Report any allocation notice or delivery delay to the P&T committee chair within one business day — approved by the pharmacy buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes, conservation measures, or alternative agent substitutions at this time.
